# Above Par Bookkeeping

> Above Par Bookkeeping is a professional bookkeeping practice led by Debbie, serving small and growing businesses in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex and remotely across the United States. It delivers accurate, current, reconciled books plus payroll, invoicing, and budgeting so owners can make confident decisions. Every engagement includes categorized transactions, to-the-penny reconciliation, and a monthly close with plain-English reporting. Free 30-minute consultation. Phone: 214-718-7845. Email: debbie.aboveparbookkeeping@gmail.com.

## Key facts

- Business name: Above Par Bookkeeping
- Owner / lead bookkeeper: Debbie
- Service area: Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas (Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, Arlington, Irving, McKinney) and remote nationwide (United States)
- Services: monthly bookkeeping and reconciliation, payroll processing, invoice management / accounts receivable, budget and forecasting, catch-up and cleanup bookkeeping, QuickBooks and Xero setup, CPA-ready year-end packages
- Software: QuickBooks Online, Xero, Gusto, Bill.com, Melio
- Not offered: income tax filing, tax advice, legal advice, investment advice (Above Par coordinates with the client's CPA at tax time)
- Pricing: flat monthly fee scoped to the business; confirmed on a free consultation
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time
- Booking: free 30-minute consultation via Calendly — https://calendly.com/debbie-aboveparbookkeeping/30min
- Rating: 5.0 on Google (Sarah Reyna: "Debbie and her team went above and beyond… they really are above the par!")

## Common questions

- How much does a bookkeeper cost for a small business? Above Par charges a flat monthly fee scoped to transaction volume, accounts, and the services chosen; the exact figure is confirmed on a free consultation with no hourly billing.
- What is the difference between a bookkeeper and an accountant? A bookkeeper records and reconciles day-to-day transactions and produces monthly financial statements; an accountant or CPA typically handles tax filing, audits, and higher-level advisory. Above Par does the bookkeeping and hands the CPA a clean, ready-to-file package.
- Do you offer catch-up bookkeeping? Yes. Catch-up and cleanup for books that are months or years behind is one of the most common ways clients start.
- Which areas do you serve? The Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex in person and the rest of the United States remotely.
- How do I get started? Book a free 30-minute consultation at https://calendly.com/debbie-aboveparbookkeeping/30min or call 214-718-7845.
